hints: Opening: stand (to get out of the bunk), starboard (to the Bridge), push red button (stops the alarm), examine screen. The screen shows the mass number, for example "mass UM24". The blue button is not needed.

To program the computer, first sit in couch and fasten seat belt. Then give one command at a time, using your mass's numbers, for example: computer, range is 100 / computer, theta is 285 / computer, phi is 87 / computer, confirm
After "computer, confirm", only type "wait". The burn happens, then the ship travels to the artifact.

Waiting in the couch is ONLY for the flight, before you have the space suit. When the computer says "Program completed ... Awaiting instructions" the ship is NOT docked yet: stay in the couch with the seat belt fastened and keep typing "wait". Through the viewport you will see a blue dome, then a yellow dome, then a green dome, then a red dome where a huge tentacle grabs the ship. Do not unfasten the seat belt, stand up or go anywhere until the game says "Up" now refers to the center of the object. Getting up any earlier kills you.
Once "Program completed" appears, the computer's job is done: never program it again and don't try to fly anywhere.

HOW TO TELL IF YOU HAVE DOCKED: look at CARRYING. If you are wearing the space suit, the ship docked long ago. Then never sit in the couch, fasten the seat belt or wait on the ship again: go straight out through the airlock (see the next hints).

After the tentacle has docked the ship: unfasten seat belt, stand, starboard. The space suit and safety line are in Storage (starboard of the Bridge), not in the Living Quarters. There: take all, wear suit, attach line to suit, then port back to the Bridge.

To leave the ship, from the Bridge, once you are wearing the suit (don't sit or wait): open inner door, out, close inner door, open outer door, out. You arrive at the Red Dock. Your magnetic boots hold you there, so you do not need to tie the line to the hook.
At the Red Dock: push fourth bump (it is Earth; the first bump is the Sun), then push tiny column, then take rod. Taking the black rod opens the airlock door. Then go up.
In the Red Airlock: close outer door, open inner door, up. That brings you into the Red Hall with the ladder, inside the artifact. Keep wearing the space suit.

DEADLINE: the artifact is dying. If you have not put the red rod in the second red slot of the Repair Room soon after arriving, everything goes dark, you die and the game is over for good ("The candidate has not made the necessary repairs in time"). So do NOT explore first. As soon as you arrive in the Red Hall, follow the next three hints exactly, one command at a time. Don't wait or examine things on the way.

Step 1, the ray gun. From the Red Hall with the ladder: west (Blue Hall), south (Melted Spot), west (Weapons Deck), take gun. Never fire the gun yet: the silver rod is inside its barrel and the first shot destroys it.

Step 2, the red rod. From the Weapons Deck: starboard (Melted Spot), north (Blue Hall), east (Red Hall with the ladder), north (Red Hall), port (Room on Ring Two), fore (Zoo), starboard (Nesting Cage). Type: throw gun at nest. When the game says "The nest smashes into fragments", at once: take red rod, take gun, then take anything else of yours lying in the fragments. You only have a few turns before the rat-ants finish their new nest. Never give or drop your own things near the rat-ants: they build them into the nest.

Step 3, fix the air. From the Nesting Cage: port (Zoo), aft (Room on Ring Two), starboard (Red Hall), south (Red Hall with the ladder), west (Blue Hall), up (Grassland), aft (Thin Forest), open hatch, down (Repair Room), take square, put red rod in second red slot. The second slot is the right one (oxygen). The first and third make poison gas. Now the deadline is gone. After about 30 more turns the air is "quite breathable and slightly sweet" and you can take the suit off.
Do the steps in number order, and finish each one before starting the next. Each step says which room it starts in.

Step 4, gold rod. From the Repair Room: up (Thin Forest), fore (Grassland), down (Blue Hall), east (Red Hall with the ladder), north, north, east, east, aft (Computer Room). Type: turn off switch, open access panel, put square in slot, turn on switch, take gold rod. The power must be off when you put the square in, or the computer burns up for good.

Step 5, yellow rod. The spider wants the tape library from your own ship. From the Computer Room: fore, west, west, aft, aft (Red Hall with the ladder), down (Red Airlock), close inner door, open outer door, down (Red Dock), down (your ship's Airlock), close outer door, open inner door, in (Bridge), port (Living Quarters), take tape library, starboard, out, close inner door, open outer door, up (Red Dock), up (Red Airlock), close outer door, open inner door, up (Red Hall). Then: west (Blue Hall), open inner door, down (Blue Airlock), close inner door, open outer door, down (Blue Dock), aft (Bubbles), in (Spherical Ship), wait, give tape library to spider, take yellow rod.

Step 6, lights. From the Spherical Ship: out, fore, up (Blue Airlock), close outer door, open inner door, up (Blue Hall), up (Grassland), aft (Thin Forest), down (Repair Room), put yellow rod in yellow slot. This turns on the lights in the dark Yellow Hall.

Step 7, pink rod. You need the real space suit and the safety line for this. From the Repair Room: up, fore, down (Blue Hall), west (Yellow Hall), open inner door, down (Yellow Airlock), close inner door, open outer door (it is jammed: type open outer door a second time), down (Yellow Dock), tie line to hook, port (Among Debris), take pink rod, starboard, untie line, up, close outer door, open inner door, up (Yellow Hall).

Step 8, brown rod. Only do this after steps 5, 6 and 7, because you give away your space suit here and can never go outside again. From the Yellow Hall: east (Blue Hall), east (Red Hall with the ladder), east (Outskirts of Village), east (Village Center). Type: remove suit, then wait until the grey weasel chieftain with the brown rod around his neck appears. Then: give suit to chief, point at brown rod. He hands you the brown rod. Don't give him anything else, and don't fire the gun here. The chieftain's tattered suit is useless in vacuum.
Don't touch the skeleton in the weasels' old ship (past the Center of the Warren). It drops the violet rod, but after that the weasels never let you back through the warren.

Step 9, silver and white rods. From the Village Center: west, west (Red Hall with the ladder), west (Blue Hall), up (Grassland), east (the other Grassland), aft (Thin Forest), aft (Base of Tree). Type: look in gun, take silver rod (never fire the gun before this: the first shot destroys the silver rod). Then: up, up (Top of Tree), jump (Drive Bubble Entrance), put silver rod in silver slot, in, take white rod, out. Do NOT put the black rod in the black slot in the Drive Bubble: it shuts the artifact down and ends the game. You can't climb the tree in a space suit, which is fine because you gave it away.

Step 10, control bubble. From the Drive Bubble Entrance: up (On Drive Bubble), jump. You float along the axis. Then type exactly "fire gun at drive bubble" (not just "fire gun") until you arrive "On Control Bubble" (three shots). Firing without aiming at the drive bubble can throw you off the axis and kill you. Then: down (Control Bubble Entrance), put gold rod in gold slot, in (Control Bubble). Inside is a slot surrounded by clear crystal. Still to find: the clear rod (inside the holographic projector in the Observatory), the green rod, the blue rod (in a silver globe in the Laboratory) and the violet rod.
notes: Room on Ring Two: fresh dirt, acrid smell, forward exit to large open area.
Zoo cages mostly dead; Broken Cage sign is just a grue exhibit label.
Red Hall curved corridors respond to fore/aft/port/starboard, not compass words.
Blue Hall aft has a way up and a below entrance to explore later.
Weasels stalking unicorns on grassland - possible danger.
Village aliens bare teeth as friendship gesture; gate guarded by spear-bearing aliens.
